rule: For operating companies retain CV <= 0.35. A higher CV passes only with a complete consecutive window of at least seven, up to ten annual observations, all finite strictly positive operating margins and finite nonnegative net income in every year, and either (A) nondecreasing margins with final > first; or (B) OLS margin slope > 0, R-squared >= 0.90, residual population SD / mean margin <= existing 0.35, positive OLS slopes in both nonoverlapping chronological halves (floor(n/2) in first), and latest margin >= previous. Missing observations, losses and sign changes disqualify both exceptions. Flat, falling, erratic, and recently deteriorating paths do not qualify for B. All other checks unchanged. Raw CV retained for valuation/price rules. Financial company rules and provisional-LTM confirmation unchanged.
parameters: Only new numerical cutoff: R-squared >= 0.90, chosen from principle: at least nine tenths of observed variation must be explained by a systematic rising trend, no more than one tenth noise. It is not estimated or optimized from returns or current-company examples. Existing 0.35 caps residual CV. Existing seven/ten history limits retained. Half-window and latest-step positive-direction checks prevent a prior rise masking recent deterioration. No return tuning.
ship_gate: US train AND Western non-US train/test AND all markets train/test: candidate CAGR >= baseline - 0.0025 AND max drawdown >= baseline - 0.02. Enumerate every changed current verdict. US 2016-2026 contaminated, excluded from decision. Missing material validation = NOT.
measurement: research-1 b1d578b analyze.py plus corrected-portfolio-function.py; adjusted total returns, first local session close, quarterly liquidation/reentry, 10bp per side, cash gaps and missing allocation, zero cash yield. USD portfolios. Three-year gross security hit rate vs same-quarter universe median, equal-weight mean of quarterly hit rates. Winner=quarter top decile; loser=negative total return, plus below-median separately.
periods: Portfolio train signals 2005Q1–2015Q3, outcomes through 2015-12-31; 2015Q4 embargoed. Later signals 2016Q1–2026Q2. Train 3y cohort outcomes must end by 2015-12-31; later mature cohorts through 2026-09-30.
comparison: Paired same-input baseline and candidate replay; stored baseline shown separately and mismatches audited. Unreplayable rows stay stored baseline in both variants, and coverage explicitly reported. Existing stored baselines are not replaced silently. Recompute downstream valuation only through unchanged existing quality-pass dependency. No fair-value variant.
scope: US by country as research-1; Western non-US uses research-1 direct venue definition; all markets includes US and non-US, with separate all-non-US sensitivity. No acquisition unless cached observations insufficient; no EODHD calls.
amendment: Pre-return-evaluation requirement correction: strict monotonicity alone omits the requested trend-consistent improvement. A current-verdict preliminary screen had found zero changes, and an incomplete numeric-only historical replay was running; no candidate portfolio, hit-rate, winner or loser outcomes had been evaluated. Retain draft and disclose both designs; only the following final candidate is evaluated against returns.
